subject: pathology
title: Osteochondroma, Osteosarcoma, Codman Triangle, Giant Cell Tumour, and Soap Bubble Lesions

steps.tx: Osteochondroma grows cartilage capped bony outgrowths from metaphyses away from joints in adolescents, solitary or hereditary multiple, malignant transformation rare and cartilage cap thickness judged. That exostosis is **osteochondroma (exostosis)**. A cartilage cap thicker than about 2 cm in a skeletally mature adult raises concern for secondary chondrosarcoma, while thin caps in growing teenagers are expected and reassuring.
steps.say: A bony stalk with cartilage cap pointing away from joint is osteochondroma, commonest benign bone tumour.

steps.tx: Osteosarcoma manufactures malignant osteoid in adolescent metaphyses around knee, sunburst spicules and Codman triangle periosteal lifting on films, lungs first metastatic home. That osteoid cancer is **conventional osteosarcoma of adolescence**. Serum alkaline phosphatase and lactate dehydrogenase add prognostic weight at diagnosis, and chest CT is mandatory because skip lesions and lung deposits change the surgical plan.
steps.say: Knee metaphysis pain, sunburst film, teenage patient: osteosarcoma until MRI and biopsy stage it.

steps.tx: Codman triangle forms when tumour lifts periosteum faster than it ossifies, a radiographic triangle at lesion margins shared by infection and Ewing tumours too. That periosteal sign is the **Codman triangle**. Seeing it should trigger urgent MRI of the whole affected bone plus chest imaging, because the sign flags an aggressive process even before histology names it.
steps.say: Codman triangle means periosteum outrun, by tumour or infection; it accuses speed, not identity.

steps.tx: Giant cell tumour of bone lyses epiphyses of young adults expansile soap bubble to subchondral plate, locally aggressive, rarely metastasising, denosumab shrinking selected. That epiphyseal lytic tumour is **giant cell tumour of bone**. Histology shows osteoclast like giant cells spread evenly among mononuclear stromal cells, and the stromal cells, not the giant cells, carry the H3F3A mutation.
steps.say: Soap bubble lysis reaching joint surface in a thirty year old is giant cell tumour territory.

steps.tx: Soap bubble describes expansile multiloculated lytic remodelling in giant cell tumour and aneurysmal bone cysts, radiographic poetry requiring histological prose. That pattern is the **soap bubble appearance of expansile bone lesions**. Fluid fluid levels on MRI point more toward aneurysmal bone cyst, which can also arise secondarily inside a giant cell tumour and mislead sampling.
steps.say: Soap bubble films narrow the list; biopsy writes the actual diagnosis every time.

steps.tx: Biopsy tract planning in bone sarcoma is oncological surgery itself because contaminated compartments amputate limb salvage options, so referral precedes biopsy always. That law is **sarcoma biopsy only at treating centre**. The biopsy tract must lie in line with the future resection incision so the entire contaminated track can be excised en bloc at definitive surgery.
steps.say: Never biopsy a suspected bone sarcoma outside the treating centre; the tract becomes tumour territory.

steps.tx: Osteosarcoma chemotherapy methotrexate doxorubicin cisplatin around limb salvage surgery, necrosis percentage after neoadjuvant therapy prognosticating powerfully. That response grade is **histological necrosis after osteosarcoma chemotherapy**. At least 90 percent tumour necrosis after neoadjuvant MAP marks a good responder, while poor necrosis predicts higher relapse risk despite complete resection.
steps.say: Ninety percent necrosis after chemotherapy is osteosarcoma's strongest good omen at resection.

steps.tx: Secondary osteosarcoma arises in Paget bone, irradiated fields, and retinoblastoma survivors decades later, older patients' new pain in Pagetic bone earning biopsy. That transformation is **secondary osteosarcoma in Paget disease and radiation**. Germline RB1 loss explains the retinoblastoma link, and radiation associated tumours typically appear after a latency well beyond five years in the treated field.
steps.say: New pain in Pagetic bone is sarcoma until biopsy acquits it, however familiar Paget pain feels.
